live.label: Live
live.means: Running, and confirmed by a check

ready.label: Set up
ready.means: Account or key exists, not in use yet

built.label: In the code
built.means: Found in the source code at the mapped commit (not run)

pending.label: Not set up
pending.means: Needs a setup step before it can work

notes.label: From notes
notes.means: Not checked; taken from older notes
